scope: Native internal ELF32 full-file reconstruction with synthetic ISF and captured module sections

verification.targeted_tests: All twelve module ELF tests passed.
checks: 16-byte symbol records and section-relative text symbol
four-byte allocator bounds ignore nonzero adjacent bytes

limitations: This extends the earlier header and symbol encoder batches; their limitations describe those historical batches. Full reconstruction now selects Elf32_Sym or Elf64_Sym using ISF pointer width.

Actual pinned method vectors cover headers and symbol normalization separately. The full synthetic ELF32 file is checked for layout consistency, not compared byte-for-byte with an actual pinned full-file extraction.
The shared synthetic memory fixture uses the existing test virtual-memory setup. This does not establish real Linux32 paging, discovery and extraction end-to-end.
The public Linux32 ISF parse gate remains closed; no real Linux32 image with exact ISF has been accepted.
No full plugin contract is established. ARM64 ModuleExtract remains unsupported by the pinned Intel ELF reconstruction contract.
